description: This file contains the definition of the Notification class within the Opencart Admin Model Tool namespace. It provides methods for managing notifications such as adding, editing status, deleting, and retrieving notifications in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Model class responsible for CRUD operations related to notifications in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Inserts a new notification record into the database with provided data and returns the last inserted ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific notification identified by notification_id.

methods.name: deleteNotification
methods.description: Deletes the notification record identified by notification_id from the database.

methods.name: getNotification
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific notification by its ID.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Fetches a list of notifications based on optional filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalNotifications
methods.description: Returns the total count of notifications based on optional filtering criteria.
